title: Martin, But He Gains 200 ELO If I DON'T Make the Best Move
summary: Martin (chess.com 250 bot) gains 200 Elo every time the player (white) does not play the engine's best move. Player opens e4 (best), then Bc4 (not best) and Martin goes to 450; rating climbs in +200 steps (650, 850, 1050, 1250, 1450, 1650, 1850 ... 2650). Player wins a piece early but the bot's rating outruns the advantage; the final game ends with Martin holding a precise drawn/winning line and the player loses ('we do in fact lose to Martin'). Goal stated: win one game.
rules: Standard chess, player is white vs Martin.
After each player move, if it was not the engine's top move, Martin's Elo increases by 200.
If the player plays the best move, Martin's Elo stays unchanged (it never decreases).
Rating rises toward engine strength (shown values reached 2650; cap 3600 inferred).
Martin's current Elo is displayed and updated after each player move.

Official site (tony-gains): bot is renamed 'Tony' (250); after each player move, if it differs from Stockfish bestMove (350 ms search) Tony gains +200, max 3600; strength chosen from rating bucket floor(r/200)*200.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin. Goal in video: win one game (player failed: final result a loss).
